content: Centrally managed endpoint DLP systems have four core components: a management server that hosts policies, classification rules, and audit data; a lightweight endpoint agent that enforces policies locally; a web-based management console for administration and reporting; and a secure communications layer, typically TLS/SSL with certificate-based mutual authentication. Optional components include intermediate endpoint servers/load balancers, Active Directory integration, and SIEM integration. Data flows from the console to the server to agents for policy distribution, and from agents back to the server for audit events and alerts.
